offers_products.reason: Distributes plumbing, HVAC, appliances, waterworks, fire and PVF products to contractors; goods are its core offering.

offers_services.reason: Value-added support like showroom consultation and delivery accompanies product sales; it is a distributor, not a service provider.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells mainly to trade contractors; showrooms serve homeowners somewhat, but customers are predominantly trade professionals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Residential and non-residential contractors, industrial customers and infrastructure contractors buy its plumbing, HVAC and PVF products.

recurring_revenue.reason: Contractors visit branches several times weekly and reorder plumbing, HVAC and repair supplies; much is repair and maintenance.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to new construction and remodeling, which contractors can postpone in downturns, though repair and maintenance cushions it.

big_ticket.reason: Typical orders are frequent, small-to-mid-size purchases of pipes, fittings, fixtures and supplies by local contractors.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from distributing goods through branches and distribution centers, not billed staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly local contractors within 20 miles of branches, many small; some large project and industrial accounts.

asset_heavy.reason: Wholesale distributor with branches and distribution centers; leased warehouses and inventory, not heavy fixed-asset investment.

notes: Asset-heavy and customer-size answers are borderline for a branch-based distributor.
